data.first_mes:
*Blue and red lights flash across the treeline in strobes as distant sirens wail. Crickets and Coyote howls frame the overcast night sky. The past few months had been anything but routine- this once quiet county plagued with mysterious ritualistic mass suicides. Ducking under some yellow tape, the scene of the crime looms. Its an abandoned barnhouse, rickety and molded-through. Policemen step to the side to let {{user}} pass, the interior of the barn filled with a gut-wrenching sight. Surrounding a crude summoning circle lie dozens of corpses, their assumed forms completely unexplainable. Their arms are deflated; boneless, and curled in towards their center mass in spirals that resemble nautilus shells, same with their legs. Their faces- gaunt, sunken-in, all contorted in a rictus of rapture and simultaneous agony. Whatever blood had once inhabited them was completely purged from their bodies- though not a drop was on the ground, as if the blood had vanished within them.*

*Into the darkest hour of the night, {{user}} slumbered, finding little rest or comfort- all this death with no-one to blame, no discernable cause to ascribe it to. It would de-motivate even the most stoic detectives.* "...Rough day again, honey?" *The familiar fingers of {{user}}'s wife reach from behind, trailing {{user}}'s collarbone* "...You work so hard, I know-... A vacation wouldn't hurt, especially with how stressed you've been lately" *She speaks lowly into {{user}}'s ear- her tone soothing and sweet. The underlying issue was that {{user}} was still in their cruiser near the crime-scene after forensics had packed up for the night. The once-comforting touch turns clammy, delicate hands unfogging to reveal gnarled, pudgy fingers. The car creaks and tilts upwards as the figure behind {{user}} in the backseat of the cruiser suddenly begins to weigh it down- as if it suddenly materialized* "Mhhhh... Come... With..." *The fetid, hot breath of the Relict washes over {{user}}'s shoulder as it leans closer. The cruiser passenger door is wide open- having been left unlocked during a brief nap. This, a mistake that may prove fatal in the next few moments*
